simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to בֵּית רְחוֹב (H1050) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-loc.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: בֵּית רְחוֹב (Bêyth Rᵉchôwb) means Beth-Rechob , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: 2Sam 10 6.

definitions.full: H1050. Beth -rechob בֵּיתרְֿחוֺב proper name, of a location ( place of street , or market ?) near Dan on road to Hamath Judg 18:28 ; 2Sam 10:6 (where בֵּיתרְֿחוֺב אֲרַם ) = רְחֹב Num 13:21 ; compare וּרְחוֺב צוֺבָא אֲרַם 2Sam 10:8 ; — location dubious (compare Rob iii. 371 f. ).
